Indirect Taxes
To pay Indirect Taxes (Customs) through the internet
Customers can log through Customs Department (ICEGATE) site or through Online SBI and pay Customs Duty.
Facility for payment of multiple challans in single debit is available.
Select the Challan to be paid.
Select State Bank of India for payment.
Customer will be redirected to the
onlinesbi.sbi
for payment.
After successful transaction, user will be redirected to ICEGATE site and the challan will no longer appear in the list of pending challans in the ICEGATE site.
Indirect Taxes (CBEC): Goods & Service Tax
State Bank provides the facility to pay indirect taxes online through
onlinesbi.sbi
. As a tax payer, you need to have a bank account enabled for net banking facility with transaction rights in anyone of our branches.
User to login at
gst.gov.in
to generate the challan.
Select State Bank of India for payment.
Customer will be redirected to the
onlinesbi.sbi
for payment.
Retail customers are also provided with a link to print the e-receipt for this payment.
In case of corporate user, the transaction will be completed only after authorization by the authoriser. On completion of successful transaction, the challan will be available to the user.
